about: Hand-authored expectations fixed before the carousel-heavy fixture or harness is run. These are item counts derived from the position cycles, never the output of the suitability evaluator.
budget_note: At indices 0 and 1 modulo 10 the post is a single image; the other eight are carousels. Carousel ordinal j has 2,3,5,10,20 slides at j modulo 5. Thus a 50-post block has 40 carousels, 320 slides and 10 singles: 330 items. The accepted image stays single. The final 2022 image replaces a 20-slide carousel, subtracting 19 items. Carousel ordinal 0 (recent index 2) lists no slides instead of two: subtract 2 items. A read that lists no slides proves nothing, so the post lands as one not yet read: one validation_pending candidate and one more truncated carousel; represented=N-1. Ordinal 4 (recent index 6) has a twenty-first child beyond the one permitted page: 20 indexed slides and one truncation, with no follow-up read. Therefore items=6.6N-21 and slides=6.4N-22. For N=500,2000,10000 the old range is whole 450-post cycles (LCM 50 kinds/sizes, 9 attribution), giving not-detected:credited:unknown=6:2:1, then subtract 19 from not-detected. For N=100 the nine ten-post old blocks sum by attribution to 426/130/52 before replacing the final 20-slide carousel, hence 407/130/52. Recent weighted counts are 50/328/1318/6598. Every fourth carousel has video at position 1 and its distinct middle position; metadata candidacy is unaffected. All ceilings remain the original post-based ceilings.

100.partial_coverage_basis: No ceiling: the coordinated scan counter ends at 100, below LISTING_CEILING, so no lane's ceiling_reached is set; remaining clears once both lanes are complete and no helper is pending or deferred (instagram_sync.py:374-376, :419-425). True while indexing, false at completion.

500.partial_coverage_basis: No ceiling: the scan counter ends at 500, below LISTING_CEILING (see the 100 row).

2000.partial_coverage_basis: No ceiling: the scan counter ends at 2000, below LISTING_CEILING (see the 100 row).

partial_coverage_basis: src/services/target/instagram_past_posts_adapter.py:42 LISTING_CEILING = 10_000, and :10-11: the newest 10,000 posts are the documented listing ceiling, not a complete inventory.

instagram_past_posts_adapter.py:505-506 _advance: ceiling_reached = (seen == LISTING_CEILING) and more = not ceiling_reached; :548 takes no next window once it is reached; :699-702 novel[:LISTING_CEILING - seen] lets the 10,000th parent in exactly, so all 10,000 are observed.

src/services/target/instagram_sync.py:693-696 _land: when the coordinated scan_seen equals LISTING_CEILING both lanes are marked complete and clamped; :88-91 _clamp_ceiling sets ceiling_reached true in each.

instagram_sync.py:419-425 status(): partial = remaining OR any lane checkpoint's ceiling_reached. remaining clears when the helpers drain (:374-376) but ceiling_reached stays, so the flag is still true at completion; progress() passes it through at :531.

src/services/target/destination_readiness.py:109-116 partial_coverage(): any drawn past-posts source is partial; src/services/target/category_mix.py:615 and :635 expose it as partial_coverage, and it is compatible with state ready (its docstring, :110-111).
So at N = 10000 the flag is true even though nothing was skipped: an account with exactly 10,000 posts cannot be told from a longer, truncated one.
